propositions: Three user-level Copilot skills (rebar-implement, rebar-janitor, rebar-debug) silently fail to register due to invalid SKILL.md frontmatter: over-character-limit descriptions and unquoted colons breaking YAML parsing.
SKILL.md frontmatter descriptions exceed the 1024-character cap enforced by GitHub Copilot CLI Agent Skills spec or contain unquoted colons that break YAML plain scalar parsing.
No deterministic linting rule exists to prevent SKILL.md frontmatter regressions at commit/CI time, allowing silent failures downstream at skill-load time.
Fix SKILL.md frontmatters by converting descriptions to YAML folded block scalars and trimming over-limit descriptions while preserving skill invocation triggers.
Add scripts/check_skill_frontmatter.py lint that validates all tracked SKILL.md files for parseable YAML, non-empty description <= 1024 chars, and valid name format, integrated into make lint target.
